title: Estonia's Fragile Coalition Faces a Dual Crisis of Governance and Fiscal… · 29 Aug
keywords: Estonia, coalition government, Riigikogu, budget deficit, inflation, fiscal policy, European Union, defence spending, political stability, eurozone, minority government, eastern flank, NATO
notes: Estonia's governing coalition has fallen to exactly half the seats in parliament following defections, stripping it of its majority and raising serious questions about its capacity to push through contested reforms. At the same time, the country faces a projected budget deficit of more than four percent of GDP, even as inflation shows signs of easing. The combination of political arithmetic and fiscal pressure is testing one of the European Union's most vocal eastern-flank members.
